This 2011 BMW 3 Series 328i xDrive delivers the combination of performance and refinement that defines the BMW brand, with a well-maintained example ready for the next owner who appreciates quality engineering and precise handling.

- Heated steering wheel
- Hard drive-based navigation system with 3-D screen and real-time traffic information
- Premium Package 2 with Dakota leather seat trim and power front seats with lumbar support
- Auto-dimming power-folding exterior mirrors with memory positioning
- Power tilt/slide glass moonroof
- Satellite radio with one-year subscription included
- iDrive system with on-board computer and voice command
- Bluetooth interface for hands-free connectivity
- Auto-dimming rearview mirror with compass
- BMW Assist with 4-year subscription
- Universal garage door opener
- Heated front seats
- Dual-zone automatic climate control
- Rain-sensing wipers

This xDrive model combines the responsiveness of its 3.0-liter six-cylinder engine with all-wheel-drive capability, delivering balanced performance across various driving conditions. The six-speed automatic transmission provides smooth power delivery while achieving 17 mpg city and 26 mpg highway. At 64,305 miles, this vehicle represents solid value for buyers seeking a well-equipped premium sedan.

The interior reflects BMW's attention to detail, featuring Dakota leather seating surfaces, genuine wood trim accents throughout the dashboard and console, and a leather-wrapped steering wheel. The power front seats offer four-way lumbar adjustment and driver-side memory function, allowing you to return to your preferred seating position each time you drive. This 2011 Toyota Corolla LE represents a reliable choice for drivers seeking practical daily transportation with proven durability and straightforward performance.

- 1.8L I4 DOHC Dual VVT-i engine with automatic transmission
- AM/FM Stereo with CD/MP3 player and 6 speakers
- Air conditioning and rear window defroster

- Brake assist with ABS brakes
- Dual front impact airbags and dual front side impact airbags
- Front and rear anti-roll bars with independent front suspension
- Heated door mirrors with power adjustment
- Telescoping and tilt steering wheel
- Trip computer with outside temperature display
- Split folding rear seat for cargo flexibility

The Corolla LE delivers consistent fuel efficiency, achieving 26 mpg in city driving and 34 mpg on the highway. This efficiency makes it an economical option for commuters and those seeking to minimize fuel expenses without sacrificing capability.

Safety features throughout this vehicle provide confidence on every drive. The combination of electronic stability control, traction control, and brake assist work together to help maintain control in challenging conditions. The comprehensive airbag system, including front and side protection, contributes to occupant security during travel.

The interior prioritizes functionality and comfort for daily use. Front bucket seats with a center armrest create an inviting cabin, while the split folding rear seat adapts to your needs, whether carrying passengers or expanding cargo space. The steering wheel adjusts both telescopically and with a tilt function, allowing you to find your ideal driving position.

Climate control features, including air conditioning and the rear window defroster, ensure comfort throughout the seasons. The intuitive control layout and trip computer keep you informed about your vehicle's performance and consumption patterns.

This brown Corolla LE comes ready for the road with all the essential features buyers expect from a Toyota. With more than 73,000 miles, this vehicle has proven its dependability and offers excellent value for practical-minded buyers. We invite you to schedule a time to drive this Corolla and experience its straightforward reliability firsthand.

This 2023 Ram ProMaster 2500 High Roof in White represents a versatile work solution designed for professionals who demand capability and functionality. With seating for two and generous cargo space, this van accommodates both driver comfort and substantial hauling capacity for your business needs.

The 3.6L V6 engine paired with a 9-Speed 948TE automatic transmission delivers dependable performance. The front-wheel-drive configuration provides stability and maneuverability, making it practical for navigating varied terrain and job sites. The heavy-duty suspension system enhances carrying capability and handling characteristics suitable for demanding work environments.

Inside, the vinyl bucket seats with driver armrest provide comfortable seating for daily operation. The Uconnect 5 infotainment system with a 7-inch display integrates Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, keeping you connected while on the job. SiriusXM radio brings entertainment during long workdays, and steering wheel-mounted audio controls allow convenient operation without distraction.

Practical features support your workflow efficiency. The MOPAR side wall paneling and cargo partition help organize your cargo area and protect your investment. The MOPAR cargo compartment floor mat protects the van's interior from wear. The ParkView rear back-up camera assists with precise maneuvering in tight spaces, while the 96-inch wide power heated mirrors provide excellent visibility and convenience.

Safety features include electronic stability control, traction control, and a comprehensive brake system with four-wheel disc brakes and ABS. The low tire pressure warning system helps maintain proper tire condition, and multiple airbags provide crash protection.

The 911 Assist emergency communication system provides peace of mind for your passengers.

Electronic stability control and traction control work together to maintain stability in challenging driving conditions. Front and side sensing systems, combined with occupant sensing airbags and overhead airbags, create a comprehensive safety environment.

This van comes equipped to handle the demands of professional and personal transportation needs. The large center console provides secure storage for essentials, while front and rear reading lights improve visibility throughout the cabin. Variably intermittent wipers with rain sensing technology adapt to changing weather without requiring manual adjustment. The low tire pressure warning system helps ensure your vehicle stays road-ready.

This 2024 Ford Transit-250 Base in white represents a practical, well-equipped work vehicle ready to handle your commercial needs. With its 3.5L V6 flex fuel engine and 10-speed automatic transmission with overdrive, this van delivers dependable performance for daily operations. The rear-wheel drive configuration provides the stability and handling characteristics essential for professional use.

The Exterior Upgrade Package elevates the van's appearance and functionality. The wiper-activated headlamps activate automatically during precipitation, ensuring optimal visibility when conditions demand it. The honeycomb mesh grille with chrome surround gives the front end a refined look, while the 16" steel wheels with full silver covers provide durability and a clean aesthetic. Black trimmed halogen lamps add visual sophistication throughout.

Cargo management is straightforward with the fixed rear cargo door and second row passenger-side glass, allowing easy access and visibility when loading and unloading materials. Six cargo tie-down hooks are strategically positioned to secure loads safely during transport. The rear-window defroster keeps your visibility clear in adverse weather conditions.

Inside, the van features front bucket seats with a driver's seat mounted armrest for comfort during long workdays. The steering wheel is both tilt and telescoping, allowing you to find your ideal driving position. The cabin includes air conditioning, power steering, power windows, and power door mirrors for convenient operation. Steering wheel mounted audio controls let you adjust your AM/FM stereo without taking your hands off the wheel.

Safety is a priority with dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, an occupant sensing airbag, and an overhead airbag protecting occupants. Electronic stability control, traction control, and ABS brakes provide confidence in various driving conditions. An exterior parking camera assists with maneuvering in tight spaces, and low tire pressure warning keeps you informed about tire condition.

This Transit-250 comes with four keys and key fobs for convenient access. Whether you're managing a small fleet or operating as an independent contractor, this van provides the features and capability you need to work efficiently. We invite you to visit our showroom to see this vehicle in person and discuss how it can serve your business needs.

The 2024 Ford Transit-350 XLT is a hardworking commercial vehicle built to handle demanding tasks with confidence and reliability. Whether you're managing a growing business or need dependable transportation for your fleet, this Transit-350 delivers the performance and functionality you require.

- Radio: AM/FM Stereo w/SYNC 4 and embedded navigation with 90-day trial
- SiriusXM satellite radio with 360L technology
- 12-inch multi-function touchscreen display
- Bluetooth connectivity and dual USB ports
- 8-speaker audio system
- Privacy glass for enhanced security and comfort
- Rear-window defroster
- Daytime running lamps for improved visibility
- 3.5L EcoBoost V6 Twin Turbocharged engine
- 10-speed automatic transmission with overdrive
- Electronic stability control and traction control
- Front and rear sensing systems
- Remote keyless entry
- Rear air conditioning

The white exterior presents a clean, professional appearance suitable for any business application. Inside, the XLT trim provides a practical cabin with cloth bucket seats and an armrest-equipped driver's seat for comfort during long workdays. The large center console offers convenient storage for essentials, while the illuminated entry makes accessing your vehicle simple regardless of the time of day.

Safety features are integrated throughout this Transit-350, including brake assist, electronic stability control, and a comprehensive airbag system with front and side impact protection. The four-wheel disc brakes provide responsive stopping power, while the front-wheel independent suspension helps absorb road imperfections for a more controlled ride. These systems work together to protect you and your cargo on every journey.

The EcoBoost 3.5L V6 Twin Turbocharged engine pairs with a 10-speed automatic transmission to deliver the power you need for commercial use. This combination provides efficient operation while maintaining the capability to handle varied terrain and demanding schedules. The rear-wheel drive configuration contributes to payload capacity and stability when fully loaded.

Practical features like power windows, power steering, and telescoping steering wheel adjustment accommodate different drivers and preferences. The tilting steering wheel adds further customization for your driving position. Auto high-beam headlights with delay-off functionality enhance night driving safety, while front fog lamps improve visibility in challenging weather conditions.

Today's businesses demand vehicles that combine reliability, safety, and modern technology. This Transit-350 XLT addresses all three, offering the dependable performance and connectivity features that keep operations moving forward.

This 2021 Ford Transit-350 XL represents a versatile commercial vehicle designed to meet the demands of businesses requiring reliable passenger and cargo transportation. With its white exterior and practical layout, this Transit is ready to serve your operational needs effectively.

- 15-Passenger seating configuration
- Heavy-Duty Trailer Tow Package with frame-mounted hitch receiver
- Tow/Haul Mode with trailer wiring provisions
- Backup camera with rear sensing system
- Lane Keep Assist
- SYNC 3 Communications & Entertainment System with AM/FM stereo
- Cruise Control with Adjustable Speed Limiting Device
- Privacy glass for occupant security and comfort
- Running boards for easier entry and exit
- Blind Spot Information System (BLIS)
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control
- Automatic headlights with fog lamps
- Dual front impact and side impact airbags
- Power steering, windows, and door mirrors
- Remote keyless entry

The V6 engine paired with a 10-Speed Automatic transmission with Overdrive delivers dependable performance for your transportation requirements. This rear-wheel-drive configuration provides the stability needed for consistent operation. The vehicle's 63,567 miles reflect moderate use, and Carfax records show two owners with no reported accidents, providing confidence in its history and maintenance.

The 15-passenger seating arrangement offers flexible configuration across five rows, accommodating groups with the comfort and safety they deserve. The Heavy-Duty Trailer Tow Package includes a frame-mounted hitch receiver, Tow/Haul Mode, and Trailer Sway Control, enabling you to connect and manage trailers effectively when needed. The tow/haul mode with trailer wiring provisions supports your equipment needs.

Interior features prioritize comfort and functionality. Cruise Control with Adjustable Speed Limiting Device allows precise speed management during city and highway operations. Privacy glass provides occupant protection while enhancing climate control efficiency. The SYNC 3 system with AM/FM stereo keeps occupants entertained, while steering wheel-mounted audio controls maintain convenient access to key functions.

Safety features throughout the vehicle demonstrate Ford's commitment to occupant protection. Lane Keep Assist helps maintain proper lane position, while the Blind Spot Information System alerts you to vehicles in blind spots. The backup camera and rear sensing system provide visibility when reversing. Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control enhance handling stability across various driving conditions. ABS brakes and multiple airbags work together to protect occupants.

This Transit-350 XL comes with available service records, and the two-owner history with no reported accidents provides assurance of careful operation. The vehicle is equipped to handle both passenger comfort and work demands, making it suitable for shuttle services, group transportation, or mixed-use operations.

We invite you to visit our showroom to see this Transit-350 XL in person. Our team is ready to discuss how this vehicle can serve your transportation needs and to answer any questions about its features and capabilities.

This 2026 Chevrolet Corvette Z06 represents the pinnacle of performance engineering, delivering track-ready capability with everyday usability. With just 489 miles, this Black Z06 is essentially new and ready for its next owner.

The black exterior finish is complemented by matching black exhaust tips and an integrated spoiler that reflects this vehicle's performance DNA. Heated and power-adjustable door mirrors with turn signal indicators enhance both comfort and visibility, while the auto-dimming rear-view mirror adds convenience for various driving conditions.

Inside, the cockpit is designed for the driver's focus and control. The GT1 bucket seats provide superior lateral support wrapped in premium Mulan leather with perforated inserts for both comfort and durability. Eight-way power adjustment on both driver and passenger seats ensures you find your ideal driving position. The sport steering wheel features leather wrapping and houses integrated audio controls for seamless command of your infotainment system.

Technology integration is comprehensive without distraction. The Infotainment 3 Plus system with Google Built-in offers navigation and connectivity alongside a 10-speaker audio system featuring SiriusXM satellite radio. The heads-up display projects critical information directly into your line of sight, maintaining focus on the road ahead.

Handling dynamics are engineered for precision. The adaptive suspension system works in concert with four-wheel independent suspension geometry and speed-sensing steering to deliver responsive, predictable performance. Electronic stability control and traction control provide confidence across varying conditions, while the four-wheel disc braking system with ABS delivers consistent, powerful deceleration.

Safety and convenience systems are fully integrated throughout the vehicle. Dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and occupant sensing technology provide comprehensive protection. Low tire pressure monitoring, emergency communication through OnStar, and a panic alarm round out the safety features. Power windows, remote keyless entry, and automatic delay-off headlights add daily convenience.

This Z06 is ready for ownership. With minimal miles and full capability intact, it awaits a driver who appreciates genuine performance engineering. We invite you to schedule your visit and experience what makes this Corvette distinctive.

The 7-speed automatic transmission provides smooth power delivery and contemporary driving dynamics. All of this is wrapped in a white exterior that makes a statement wherever you go.

This Mustang Shelby GT500 awaits a driver ready to experience what serious American performance delivers. Contact us to schedule your time behind the wheel and discover why this machine belongs in your garage.

Discover the 2023 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray 3LT, a striking Red sports car that combines athletic performance with refined luxury. With just 1,600 miles, this vehicle is virtually new and ready to deliver the driving experience you've been seeking.

- Android Auto and Apple CarPlay connectivity
- Navigation system with Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium
- Heated and ventilated leather seats with power adjusters
- Z51 Performance Package with Magnetic Selective Ride Control suspension
- Performance brakes with edge red-painted calipers
- 19" front and 20" rear forged aluminum wheels with high-performance tires
- Bose Performance Series sound system with 14 speakers and SiriusXM
- Head-Up Display for enhanced driver awareness
- Performance exhaust with stainless-steel tips
- Electronic Limited-Slip Differential
- Rear Camera Mirror and blind spot alert
- Park Assist technology
- Remote engine starter
- Heated steering wheel
- Heavy-duty cooling system

The heart of this Corvette is its potent 6.2L V8 engine paired with an 8-speed dual clutch transmission, delivering responsive performance whether you're cruising at highway speeds or pushing through urban streets. The rear-wheel-drive platform provides the authentic sports car handling this nameplate is known for, while achieving 16 mpg in the city and 24 mpg on the highway.

Inside, you'll find a driver-focused cabin wrapped in premium materials. The GT2 bucket seats feature napa leather with perforated inserts and heated capability, while the sueded microfiber-wrapped upper interior trim adds a touch of sophistication. Memory settings for both driver and passenger seats ensure your preferences are always ready, and the heated steering wheel provides comfort during colder months.

The Z51 Performance Package elevates this Stingray with track-tested enhancements including adaptive suspension technology, upgraded braking systems, and a performance-tuned rear axle. The adjustable front lift system with memory helps protect the front end in everyday driving, while the removable roof panel offers open-air enjoyment on demand.

Advanced technology and safety features work seamlessly throughout the vehicle. The performance data and video recorder lets you capture your drives, while rear cross traffic alert and side blind zone monitoring provide confidence in any driving situation. Wireless charging keeps your devices powered, and the universal garage door transmitter adds convenience to your daily routine.

This non-smoker vehicle has been thoroughly detailed and is ready for its next owner. Every system is functioning perfectly, and the minimal mileage ensures years of enjoyment ahead.

The 2026 Mercedes-Benz CLE 53 AMG® 4MATIC® delivers refined performance and sophisticated design for those who demand both capability and elegance.

- 3.0L I6 Turbo engine with 9-Speed Automatic transmission and 4MATIC® all-wheel drive
- AMG® Performance Steering Wheel in Nappa Leather
- 11.9" Center Touchscreen Display with MBUX navigation system
- Apple CarPlay®/Android Auto® with wireless connectivity
- Burmester® Surround Sound System with 15 speakers and SiriusXM Satellite Radio
- AMG® Night Package II and AMG® Night Package Plus
- Power Panorama moonroof
- Heated front seats with MB-Tex/Microfiber upholstery and red stitching
- 20" AMG® Black Multi-Spoke Y-Design wheels
- Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC® with speed control
- Adaptive suspension with speed-sensing steering
- Automatic high-beam headlights with delay-off functionality
- Rear parking camera with 4-wheel independent suspension
- Dual front and side impact airbags with rear side airbags
- Emergency communication system with Mercedes-Benz Emergency Call Service

This red exterior coupe presents itself with commanding presence through its darkened AMG® specific radiator grille, high-gloss black elements, and distinctive badging. The 19" and 20" AMG® multi-spoke wheels with black accents speak to the vehicle's athletic stance, while body-color bumpers and a rear spoiler enhance its aerodynamic profile.

Inside, the driver-focused cockpit combines comfort with control. Power-adjustable front bucket seats with heated functionality and memory settings conform to your preferences, while the auto tilt-away steering wheel and telescoping column ensure accessibility. The metal weave center console with piano black lacquer trim and front center armrest create an upscale cabin environment.

Technology seamlessly integrates into daily driving. The MBUX navigation system pairs with the 11.9" touchscreen for intuitive operation, while wireless Apple CarPlay® and Android Auto® keep you connected without added clutter. The Burmester® Surround Sound System elevates every journey with precision audio clarity across 15 speakers, complemented by SiriusXM Satellite Radio and HD Radio capability.

Performance and safety work in concert. The 3.0L turbocharged six-cylinder engine partners with the 9-Speed Automatic transmission and 4MATIC® all-wheel drive to deliver balanced driving dynamics. Active Distance Assist DISTRONIC® helps maintain safe following distances, while electronic stability control, traction control, and six airbags—including knee and overhead protection—prioritize occupant security.

This vehicle will not disappoint those seeking a luxury coupe engineered for both metropolitan streets and open highways. We invite you to experience this 2026 Mercedes-Benz CLE 53 AMG® 4MATIC® firsthand and discover why it represents the pinnacle of German automotive excellence.
